name: dance_card.v2.concave_judges
coefficient_rule: k_N = 100 / E[sum over a median-seat N-couple roster of (couple season judges total)^p] on the app's schedule model (src/lib/strong-play-ceilings.ts: 12 couples, 4-couple finale, judges 28->21). Same yardstick that produced legacy 0.2449. No couple or manager outcomes used.
weekly_input: per night: collapseToNights (all marks over all marks possible x30, points rows in numerator only; Kylie 2026-11-04), summed over a week's nights; episode_results.bonus_points added to the week's input like a points row (provisional; zero in all published data)
start_week: league Anchor Week (judges_score_starts_week) = 2 for all four leagues = first week after each draft completed
rounding: per league per couple: V(t)=round_half_up_cents(k_N * S(t)^p); weekly couple increment = V(t)-V(t-1); manager roster_points(week) = sum of its couples' increments; total = round_cents(roster*w_judges + stored prediction*w_elim + stored GF*w_bonus)
